capabilities: Detect JIRA ticket URLs in pasted text
Rewrite pasted links to use the issue number as the title
disambiguation: Does not fetch or sync JIRA data; it only rewrites the link text of pasted URLs.
extras: README is minimal and its example appears malformed (shows input and result 'PRJ-1234' without the full transformed output); no configuration options documented.
intentEvidence: It's a very simple plugin which captures pasted text and if it detects it's a link to a JIRA ticket
problem: Pasting a JIRA link into a note leaves a long URL or generic title instead of a readable issue reference.
summary: Paste handler that rewrites pasted JIRA ticket URLs as Markdown links titled with the issue number (e.g. PRJ-1234).
